tool_args.rationale: The authorized mechanism guidance requires the high-gradient regime probe when s_grad exceeds 2.36. It can distinguish a supercritical avalanche from the smooth concave base before fitting the five-parameter law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth siphon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, inside the explicitly uncertified supercritical gray zone; the threshold and avalanche strength are not identifiable from subcritical observations.
A high-gradient boundary probe directly resolves the relevant threshold ambiguity at lower cost.
It does not resolve the supercritical gradient mechanism.
